name: crimeverse-ai
description: CRIMEVERSE AI 2.0 - Unified Multi-Source Crime Intelligence & Prevention Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ..
